name: ADR Agent

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'include/**'
      - 'lib/**'
      - 'CMakeLists.txt'
      - 'Makefile'
      - '.github/workflows/**'

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write

jobs:
  validate-and-generate-adr:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get changed files
        id: get_changed_files
        run: |
          echo "files<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          git diff --name-only ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }} ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }} >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Get diff
        id: get_diff
        run: |
          echo "diff<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          git diff ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }} ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }} >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Check for existing ADR changes
        id: check_adr_changes
        run: |
          # Check if the PR already modifies files in docs/adr/
          if git diff --name-only ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }} ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }} | grep -q "^docs/adr/"; then
            echo "adr_exists=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "adr_exists=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Run ADR Validation Agent
        if: steps.check_adr_changes.outputs.adr_exists == 'false'
        uses: github/super-linter-action@v5
        with:
          # Note: Since github/copilot-agent-action@v1 does not exist, we simulate the agent behavior
          # by using a script that would typically invoke the agent or perform the validation logic.
          # In a real scenario, you would replace this with a valid action or a custom script.
          # For the purpose of this workflow, we will use a placeholder script.
          pass: true
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Simulate ADR Agent Execution
        if: steps.check_adr_changes.outputs.adr_exists == 'false'
        run: |
          echo "Running ADR Validation Agent..."
          echo "Changed files:"
          echo "${{ steps.get_changed_files.outputs.files }}"
          echo "Diff:"
          echo "${{ steps.get_diff.outputs.diff }}"
          
          # Placeholder for actual ADR validation and generation logic
          # This would typically involve calling an external service or running a local script
          # that analyzes the code changes and generates ADRs if necessary.
          
          # Example: Check if any new architectural decisions are detected
          if [ -z "${{ steps.get_changed_files.outputs.files }}" ]; then
            echo "No significant changes detected."
          else
            echo "Significant changes detected. Generating ADRs..."
            # Logic to generate ADRs would go here
          fi
